bgm.name: BGM
bgm.tip: Stop the playing BGM and play the new audio

bgs.name: BGS
bgs.tip: Stop the playing BGS and play the new audio

cv.name: CV
cv.tip: Stop the playing CV and play the new audio

se.name: SE
se.tip: Multiple sound effects can be played at the same time

se-attenuated.name: SE - Attenuated
se-attenuated.tip:
Play the sound effect at the specified position and automatically adjust the volume
The farther the sound position is from the center of the camera, the more attenuated it will be
The relevant settings can be modified in <Project Settings>

playAudio-location.label: Sound Position
playAudio-location.tip: Play the sound effect at a specified position, attenuating the volume as it moves away from the center
